instruction.text: Fill in the gaps of the summary with the correct form of indirect speech.

hint.text: The blue colored text is the original statement from which you have to form the indirect speech.

atoms.a: <t-blue>“Rents are increasing by up to 15% annually in some districts.”</t-blue>
atoms.b: The article deals with rising rent prices in urban areas. A real estate analyst explains that rents ((are_increasing)) by up to 15% annually in some districts.
